+"""Cache directory creation that surfaces permission problems."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import errno
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def strict_cache_permissions(cache_dir: Path) -> bool:
+    """Attempt to create the given directory and sub-directories exist.
+
+    Behaves like :func:`_pytest.assertion.rewrite.try_makedirs`, except that
+    :class:`PermissionError` is propagated instead of returning False, so
+    callers can report permission problems.
+
+    Returns True if successful or if it already exists.
+    """
+    try:
+        os.makedirs(cache_dir, exist_ok=True)
+    except (FileNotFoundError, NotADirectoryError, FileExistsError):
+        # One of the path components was not a directory:
+        # - we're in a zip file
+        # - it is a file
+        return False
+    except PermissionError:
+        raise
+    except OSError as e:
+        # as of now, EROFS doesn't have an equivalent OSError-subclass
+        #
+        # squashfuse_ll returns ENOSYS "OSError: [Errno 38] Function not
+        # implemented" for a read-only error
+        if e.errno in {errno.EROFS, errno.ENOSYS}:
+            return False
+        raise
+    return True

--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/test_strict_cache_permissions.py
@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import errno
+from functools import partial
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from _pytest.strict_cache_permissions import strict_cache_permissions
+import pytest
+
+
+def test_strict_cache_permissions(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path
+) -> None:
+    p = tmp_path / "foo"
+
+    # create
+    assert strict_cache_permissions(p)
+    assert p.is_dir()
+
+    # already exist
+    assert strict_cache_permissions(p)
+
+    # monkeypatch to simulate all error situations
+    def fake_mkdir(p: Path, exist_ok: bool = False, *, exc: OSError) -> None:
+        assert isinstance(p, Path)
+        raise exc
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "makedirs", partial(fake_mkdir, exc=FileNotFoundError()))
+    assert not strict_cache_permissions(p)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "makedirs", partial(fake_mkdir, exc=NotADirectoryError()))
+    assert not strict_cache_permissions(p)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "makedirs", partial(fake_mkdir, exc=FileExistsError()))
+    assert not strict_cache_permissions(p)
+
+    err = OSError()
+    err.errno = errno.EROFS
+    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "makedirs", partial(fake_mkdir, exc=err))
+    assert not strict_cache_permissions(p)
+
+    err = OSError()
+    err.errno = errno.ENOSYS
+    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "makedirs", partial(fake_mkdir, exc=err))
+    assert not strict_cache_permissions(p)
+
+    # PermissionError is propagated
+    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "makedirs", partial(fake_mkdir, exc=PermissionError()))
+    with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
+        strict_cache_permissions(p)
+
+    # unhandled OSError should raise
+    err = OSError()
+    err.errno = errno.ECHILD
+    monkeypatch.setattr(os, "makedirs", partial(fake_mkdir, exc=err))
+    with pytest.raises(OSError) as exc_info:
+        strict_cache_permissions(p)
+    assert exc_info.value.errno == errno.ECHILD
+
+
+def test_strict_cache_permissions_file_component(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    f = tmp_path / "file"
+    f.touch()
+    assert not strict_cache_permissions(f / "sub")
+    assert not strict_cache_permissions(f)
